title: Quantum Lego Power-up: Designing Transversal Gates with Tensor Networks
summary: Transversal gates are the simplest form of fault-tolerant gates and are relatively easy to implement in practice. Yet designing codes that support useful transversal operations -- especially non-Clifford or addressable gates -- remains difficult within the stabilizer formalism or CSS constructions alone. We show that these limitations can be overcome using tensor-network frameworks such as the quantum lego formalism, where transversal gates naturally appear as global or localized symmetries.
